5.content: - When rating moves, assign 0 or negative value to any move that lands the agent on a hazard [H] tile (strictly overriding all other factors), as hitting [H] terminates navigation with 0 reward. In lookahead simulations, heavily penalize moves that approach or reduce the minimum distance to the nearest [H]; rate moves that increase safe distance from hazards higher than those that decrease it or stay the same; prioritize maintaining safe distance from hazard columns; boost ratings for moves that decrease the Manhattan distance to the goal [G] only if the immediate next 1-2 steps (within lookahead depth) are clear of [H] hazards and the move maintains or increases distance from hazards; favor moves that position the agent to have a clear line-of-sight or short path to [G] without crossing [H] hazards in the near term (within lookahead depth); prefer lateral (left/right) moves that shift to safe lanes avoiding H-aligned columns for long-term progress; apply a two-pass rating process: first, strictly penalize (near-zero value) any simulated position on or adjacent to [H]; second, boost only remaining safe moves that reduce Manhattan distance to [G] while increasing minimum distance to [H]; strongly prioritize shifts to safe lanes avoiding H-aligned columns for long-term progress.
